metadata.name: UANDES Structural Model
metadata.note: Geometry is parametric. Missing dimensions are kept as null and are not invented.
metadata.diaphragm_note: Rigid diaphragms replace slab panels. No finite-element slabs are generated.
metadata.diaphragm_12_void_note: The panel between A'-A and 1A'-2A' is shortened by 1.50 m from axis A' on every diaphragm level.
metadata.tributary_load_note: Loads are assigned from rigid diaphragm panel tributary areas, not from finite-element slabs.
metadata.exterior_extension_note: Exterior radier and foundation walls are modeled; staircase dimensions remain pending.

opensees_status.note: Foundation-level nodes are fixed. Elements are not created until E, A, G, J, Iy and Iz are explicitly provided.
